claims: Black Cat (Felicia Hardy) joins Marvel Rivals as a Duelist hero in Season 7.5.
Black Cat is voiced by Erica Lindbeck.
Black Cat is part of the Season 7.5 update on April 17, 2026.
Black Cat's Grappling Hook is used for mobility, traversal, and stealing Fortune from opponents.
Black Cat's Claw Attacks deal quick, close-range damage.
Fortune buffs Black Cat's claw attacks.
Black Cat's Fortune mechanic allows her to exchange accumulated Fortune for enhanced abilities including invisibility, area reveals, portal creation, and cleansing effects.
Black Cat's Ultimate is a phantom-like attack that allows her to dive into enemies, marking them for critical damage.
Black Cat has a Team-Up Ability called "Lucky Loan".
Black Cat's "Lucky Loan" provides luck to teammates like White Fox and Captain America, strengthening their abilities.
Black Cat has alternate skins like "Urban Predator".
